description: The Fuaran number-FORMATTING conformance family (WIRE_FORMAT.md 27.8.2). Each vector is (value, format, expected text): `value` is a JSON number (a negative zero is written `-0.0`), `format` a canonical `CellFormat`, and `expectedText` the text every conformant host renders for that number under that format - the projection behind a Metric value and trend, a LabelValueRow value and a grid cell. The text is the hydrating JavaScript's, so a server-rendered figure and its hydration agree byte for byte: `None` and `DateTime` are `String(x)`; `Number` is `x.toFixed(d)`, or with no declared places `x.toFixed(0)` for an integer and `String(x)` otherwise; `Percent` is `(x * 100).toFixed(d)` plus `%` (one place by default); `Currency` is the code, a space and `x.toFixed(2)`; `SignificantDigits` is `Number(x.toPrecision(d)).toString()`. The text depends on no locale. Generated from the reference host's own formatter, which PROVES every vector, through its decoder, before this file is written.

vectors.description: the cell vocabulary's currency is the ISO code, a space and two places
below 1e21 String(x) is positional, where a host's general format goes exponential
String(x) turns exponential at 1e21, lower-case and signed
String(-0) is 0: a negative zero carries no sign
the shortest digits that round-trip, not a rounded display

from 1e-6 String(x) stays positional
toFixed answers String(x) from 1e21 up

an integer with no declared decimals is toFixed(0)
a negative zero is an integer, and toFixed(0) does not sign it
toFixed(0) of an exact half rounds up in magnitude
declared places do not apply from 1e21 up
fixed places, no grouping, a point

a negative amount keeps its sign when it rounds to zero
a negative zero is not less than zero, so it is unsigned
an exact binary tie rounds away from zero, not to even
one place by default, after the x100
0.005 x 100 is exactly 0.5, and the tie rounds up
declared places on the scaled ratio
a negative zero ratio renders unsigned
more digits than the value needs adds no trailing zeros
String(x) of the rounded value is exponential from 1e21
an exact tie at the last significant digit rounds away from zero
three significant digits of 1234 are 1230, never 1.23E+03
rounded to three digits, then spelled by String(x)
a small value stays positional from 1e-6
